Separate port-body phase restores native safe paths, enables Survey through the desk and enters actual native Surf. All four water-facing sides and8 rear bases checked; normal disembark and actual desk OFF restore dry play. No map/warp/player position/flag writes. Random encounters suppressed only in test RAM by shared harness.
